display_information.name: PeopleTech Flow Workday
display_information.description: Request time off and approve Workday changes from Slack. Every write needs a human approver.
display_information.long_description: PeopleTech Flow Workday (workday-mcp-schema) lets linked employees open a time-off form with /workday, sends the request to the assigned approver as a direct message with Approve and Reject buttons, and lets the requester submit the approved request to Workday with their own Workday sign-in. Nothing is written to Workday without an approval.

slash_commands.description: Time off form, request status, submit an approved request, link your Workday account
slash_commands.usage_hint: [timeoff | status apr_... | submit apr_... | link | help]

shortcuts.name: Request time off
shortcuts.description: Open the Workday time-off request form
